notes.title: 💨 Beta Ain’t Ready! But We’re Still Goin’ FULL SAIL! ⛵
notes.content:
[h1]🏴‍☠️ Ahoy there, gamer crew! Ye better batten down the hatches, cause we’ve been workin like mad pirates in a code storm![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/5b63519bc0e37f55aaa24eaf0188cd84f99a6e22.png"][/img][/p][p]🪢 Craftin' systems? Check! Custom loot? Double check! And modular pirate vehicles that look like they were dreamt up in a fever fueled dream? Ohhh, we got those too!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/49da71ca66d2a125495953cc5cf4e45d42f2be9f.png"][/img][/p][p]🧥 We’ve added crafting, gear, clothing and vehicles that’d make even a kraken jealous! From buildin’ wild contraptions to stackin’ yer loot, the game’s gettin’ juicier than a barrel of salty-soaked coconuts! But don’t ye be thinkin’ we’re done yet! There’s still some magic brewin’ below deck. We’re buildin’ tweakin’ and makin’ this beast of a game seaworthy![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/b00a368fac838bf19c0d69ae0a9afdc42984cc5b.png"][/img][/p][p]⛵ We’re sailin’ straight toward open beta testing, and it’s comin’ faster than a cannonball in a tavern brawl! Just a couple more blue moons, and ye might be among the first to set foot on all the Islands! So what’s next, ye ask? This be a sneak peek at the WILD ride ahead, with construction chaos, cannon-blastin' fun, and more voxel madness than Davy Jones can handle![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/ea77011c94fdf86d9759025b1652bac477ae3798.png"][/img][/p][p]🧜‍♀️ So what are ye waitin’ for, ya brave sea dogs?! This ain’t just any island, This is Battle Island, forged in fire, built with voxels, and soaked in glory! If ye be tired of the same old grind, if yer heart beats for chaos, loot, and cannon-blastin’ madness, then hoist yer colors and join us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/42b577e91132133ce755dcffcebbbb572158b2d3.png"][/img][/p][p]🗣️ Wishlist us on Steam. Join the Discord crew. Follow the journey. And prepare to test yer mettle in open beta! We be just two devs, but we’ve built a world that refuses to be ignored, a world that screams ADVENTURE, and kicks you in the loot chest when you least expect it! So sharpen yer swords, load the cannons, and slap on yer fanciest eye patch! Because the tide’s risin’ fast, and Battle Island waits for no one![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/078023377c07da3bc80a04b406ad7bbac2c330e6.png"][/img][/p][p]🧜‍♂️ This be your chance, to leave yer mark, or be left in the sand. We ain't just buildin’ a game, WE'RE LAUNCHIN' A LEGEND! Open beta’s comin’ fast, and trust me, ye won’t want to miss the BOOM![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/399940f06a182210cef54b1b6ab35a934db9be23.png"][/img][/p][p]⚠️ Visuals, performance, and mechanics be subject to change as we steer toward open beta.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="TxIp7TB8kU4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🕹️ is Coming to the Steam Deck 🎮
notes.content:
🧭 YAARRGH! Battle Island! is officially coming to the Steam Deck! That’s right, soon you'll be able to take your co-op skeleton slaying, island defending, treasure digging adventures on the go! Whether you’re on a long voyage or just lounging in port, the full pirate experience will now fit in your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/920aa041f7fab8163e6be8773ca90b63807d15d7.gif[/img]

🏴‍☠️ What to Expect:
[list]
[*] Seamless performance and optimized controls for the Steam Deck.
[*] Full support for co-op multiplayer, crafting, mining, and wave based skeleton combat.
[*] A perfect fit for bite sized raids or epic build sessions.
[*] Treasure hunting from the comfort of your hammock!
[/list]

🔧 Under the Hood
We’re currently testing and optimizing the game to make sure it runs smoothly on Valve’s handheld powerhouse. The stylized visuals and sandbox gameplay feel right at home on the Deck and we're loving the results so far!

🎥 Want to see it in action?
We’ll be sharing gameplay footage, updates, and behind the scenes progress on our YouTube Channel, so be sure to subscribe and stay in the loop!

🏗️ Thank you for supporting us on this journey. With your help, YAARRGH! Battle Island! is becoming a game you can enjoy anywhere you go. Keep your blades sharp and your cannons ready, the skeleton horde doesn’t stand a chance!

🏝️ See ye on the island, Deck pirates!

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🏴‍☠️ The Most Insane Voxel World! 🔥
notes.content:
Ahoy, ye landlubbers! Gather ’round for some BIG news from the high seas!

[previewyoutube=ubbhy9cQhrM;full][/previewyoutube]

This be Volumetric Voxels a whole new way to bring voxel worlds to life! No more flat, lifeless blocks. Now we’ve got swirling fog, glowing light, and rolling waves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/72c1b6a30d92c9dc23e3ca1964beef1afd3e053e.png[/img]

With this magic, we can summon Volumetric Fog to creep over yer world, light up yer darkest caves with Volumetric Lighting, flood yer mines with Volumetric Water, and dive into underwater realms that'll make yer ship's crew jump overboard in awe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/8f84133a98d7991f6dcb0e716573af77ca51bd30.png[/img]

Thick fog drifts across the land. Deep caves glow with flickerin’ lantern light. And when the mines flood? The water rushes in, filling every tunnel and crack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/6b092b523539e980cfabdd7afe2f7c71392d644a.png[/img]

And the ocean? It ain’t just a blue puddle anymore it’s ALIVE! Dive beneath the waves and see a whole new world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/101ff0cc84c4d9241a45b9c7f52abf8a00f4980a.png[/img]

Fog so thick, ye could lose yer own hook hand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/8e2e5de5ce2abbd8a04c542e686202117480d826.png[/img]

Caves so dark, even a ghost pirate wouldn’t dare enter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/a91a4c0f173d566a10826342c01c343228525308.png[/img]

And when the mines flood… well, hope ye brought a sea straw! Or at least a really good pardon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/655bce3182f3dc640d2e99d2d10cedee0c241690.png[/img]

This water’s so real, ye might just start holdin’ yer breath when ye dive in! Don’t worry, we ain’t responsible for passin’ out at the helm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/8e2e5de5ce2abbd8a04c542e686202117480d826.png[/img]

And if ye see bubbles risin’ from the deep… run. Ain’t no fish that farts that big!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/834babc91f6992f39ee3153842af381392ef41a5.png[/img]

So grab yer gear, hoist the anchor, and get ready for adventure! This be voxel gaming like ye’ve NEVER seen before!

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🌌 Volumetric Voxels, A Stunning Fusion of Style & Tech
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0DVe-a3f_3U;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re redefining voxel rendering with a unique, stylized aesthetic that blends the best of Rasterization, Ray Marching, and Ray Tracing. This cutting-edge mix doesn’t just make our voxel world look great—it makes it feel alive.


To push the immersion even further, we’ve developed a Volumetric Lighting Simulation that works in harmony with Volumetric Fog Effects and even Volumetric Water Simulation. Light pierces through misty landscapes, fog swirls dynamically around your character, and water reacts in a beautifully simulated way—bringing unparalleled depth and atmosphere to the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/fee0bf0a2cb06a903f9a94fa3cbcc16151f1eb29.png[/img]

🌟 Glowing embers dance in the air.
🌊 Soft fog rolls through the valleys.
🌅 Golden sunsets cast dramatic, stylized shadows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/5718f320658f6d35d605e1d003fb87314e0d02af.png[/img]

🔦 True-to-life underground darkness
Our lighting system doesn’t just enhance the world above—it transforms the experience below. With realistic volumetric effects, light and fog won’t travel deep into mining tunnels and caves. As you descend, the air grows heavy, the light fades, and the shadows deepen, creating a true sense of mystery and adventure. Will you bring a torch, or brave the unknown?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/aa8b95d3c9e71a3dae86b8209f4dce905048d7d7.png[/img]

Every detail is crafted to enhance the game’s bold, artistic look, striking a perfect balance between realism and fantasy. The result? A visually stunning, hand-crafted voxel world bursting with atmosphere and adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/4c8dd27a43eb725c8b8b66622ead2625e5198f73.png[/img]

This isn’t just another blocky world—it’s a place where light, color, and movement create an unforgettable experience. Get ready to mine, build, and explore in a voxel world like no other!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/aab4bf4bb17fbc0417e261a0fa5a2de0807a5eca.png[/img]

🚀 Stay tuned as we push the boundaries of voxel artistry!

notes.title: 🌊 YAARRGH! Battle Island! 🌊 Enters PlayTesting: A Voyage Begins
notes.content:
🏝️ Ahoy, adventurers and sandbox enthusiasts! We’re thrilled to announce that YAARRGH! Battle Island! has officially set sail into the exciting waters of PlayTesting. With three distinct stages planned, this marks a monumental milestone in our journey to create a groundbreaking procedural voxel battle arena. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/38345584ef343ea667f093c719cb6c28ab6c52ef.png[/img]

⛏️ Alpha Testing: Building the Foundations
The Alpha phase has commenced! This stage is exclusive to our development team as we focus on merging the core systems that will power the game. Think of this as the skeleton of our creation—mining, building, crafting, and more are being stitched together to lay a robust foundation for the action-packed co-op and AI wave combat you’ve been eagerly awaiting. While this phase is barebones, it’s the crucial groundwork for the adventure to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/4329a639efdaeab65a68ef2d5e57fb3f09afe984.png[/img]

⚓ Beta Testing: Setting the Scene
Our sights are already on the next stage—Beta testing. This is where the magic truly begins to unfold. With integrated gameplay, polished animations, and refined mechanics, the game will take shape into a more cohesive experience. And here’s the exciting part: Beta testing will be open to all our incredible supporters who have stood by us over the years. Your feedback will play a key role in shaping the final product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/4cfc1056502ce64a92b47f8e78afa932be31b364.png[/img]

🗺️ Open PlayTest: Charting New Horizons
Once the Beta phase smooths out the rough seas, we’ll expand the PlayTest to a wider audience. This phase focuses on massive-scale testing, tweaking, and refining, as well as actively listening to community feedback. The public PlayTest will be accessible to everyone who has requested access through our Steam Store Page. Get ready to dive in, share your thoughts, and help us make YAARRGH! Battle Island! the best it can be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/e612b4953b33f51fa728c43a5ab0f75459a04ab3.png[/img]

💪 Join the Crew
Excited to be part of this journey? Wishlist YAARRGH! Battle Island! on Steam and request access to our PlayTests here: Steam Store Page. Together, we’ll explore, battle, and craft the ultimate sandbox experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/4b4e8b12c9a2006caf35525a32d4d9f616e64dc0.png[/img]

🦜 Thank you for your unwavering support and enthusiasm as we sail closer to release. Let the games begin, and may the winds be ever in our favour!?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/055907f3e9d0bc253db60fd7661ff5b6f36aeacd.png[/img]

⚠️ Please note: the Open PlayTest is still some time away as we continue refining the game mechanics and tackling lingering bugs. Be sure to wishlist and request access to the public PlayTest through our Steam Store Page to stay updated on our progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/08ad41b5ac434f1d7eb97c9b7c4b136ee381047e.png[/img]

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🏴‍☠️ Double the Beards Double the Trouble! ⚔️
notes.content:
☠️ YAARRGH! 🏴‍☠️ Double the Beards Double the Trouble! ⚔️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/a91a4c0f173d566a10826342c01c343228525308.png[/img]

Ahoy there, me hearties! We've got a swashbucklin' adventure lined up for ye. We'll be plungin' into the mysterious waters of YAARRGH! Where our fearless Captain Ginger Beard and his lookalikes are runnin' amok on this desert island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/c82ad2b4df8e7d229ccc17f7f4f8639e5d80ff68.png[/img]

We’ve been tirelessly working to transform YAARRGH! into an engaging multiplayer experience. It’s been a challenging journey, tackling the complexities of networking and synchronizing a voxel world across the internet. But now, we’re thrilled to announce that our pirate world can be enjoyed with others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/862b13e8b79d087950f455a524e1b66b22f97715.png[/img]

The integration of multiplayer functionality has been our biggest hurdle to date. If you’ve been following our progress over the years, you’ll have seen the evolution of our game. After successfully prototyping player networking, our final major task was to network the entire voxel world. Today, we’re excited to share the results of our hard work with you in our game, called YAARRGH!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/38345584ef343ea667f093c719cb6c28ab6c52ef.png[/img]

With the fundamental multiplayer systems now in place, we can shift our focus to implementing the various features we’ve developed during prototyping. With these solid foundations laid, our next steps involve adding rich game content and enhancing AI to create a truly immersive experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/b4c53d6b2b90953c127ea223e0e048df66041b7b.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support as we bring YAARRGH! to life.

[previewyoutube=nMldPGR-j1g;full]https://youtu.be/nMldPGR-j1g?si=cGy6IfX3JrrmWhxO[/previewyoutube]

Fair winds and happy gaming!

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! 🏴‍☠️ Meet Captain Ginger Beard: Tales from the High Seas!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=obELPZZhMuo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Cap'n Ginger Beard[/h1] be a swashbucklin', plunderin', craftin', and fightin' son of a salty dog, with more tales to tell than stars in the sky! Some say he were hatched from an egg atop a mountain, but such tales be naught but fanciful yarns spun by landlubbers and fools!

Nay, the truth be far more fantastical! Cap'n Ginger Beard were not born, but fashioned from the very stuff of legend—a single polygon plucked from the ether, molded by the hands of fate into the fearsome pirate ye see afore ye today!

So, hoist yer Jolly Roger high, me hearties, and prepare to embark on a voyage filled with adventure, treasure, and the legend of Cap'n Ginger Beard! 🏴‍☠️

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! Me Matey!
notes.content:
[h3]🚢 Ahoy, me hearties![/h3] Dive into the briny depths of mystery as we unveil the secrets behind YAARRGH!, the voxel game that's been simmering in our pirate cove for years! Join us on this swashbuckling journey where we answer the age-old questions: What be these YAARRGH! videos all about? What in the seven seas are ye watchin'? Most crucially, do ye even give a care?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/13509e1270e2bf40323d8b8854d64b74f306fba4.gif[/img]

[h3]⚔️ Embark on an epic adventure:[/h3] As we navigate the development seas, from the very first prototype in 2016 to the rebuilt voxel engine in 2023 and the thrilling emergence of YAARRGH! as a fully-fledged game. Pirates, monsters, and uncharted islands await ye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/d8d7c2faaee99988101b82f59c0fe64d65d1d4b9.png[/img]

[h3]🎥 Sit Back, Relax, and Enjoy:[/h3] Answer the call, join our crew, and savor the rest of the video. The sea awaits, and so does the excitement!

[previewyoutube=Gqza41zNxKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🌊 Highlights:[/h3]

🧭 Unveiling the initial prototype in 2016: Creatures of the deep, monsters, and the pursuit of a sea- 
     smooth voxel world with AI.

🧭 Setting sail in 2020 with YAARRGH! Battle Island: Testing multiplayer and networking for a game that 
     plays well with others.

🧭 Navigating the pandemic seas in 2021: Recovering health, operational capabilities, and our 
     determination to craft YAARRGH!

🧭 Reforging the voxel engine in 2023: Harder, better, faster, stronger, sailing natively on the Steam Deck.

🧭 In the year 2024: A new era dawns, where a prototype becomes a game! Explore, mine, craft, and 
     build with yer crew, facing skeleton hordes to secure valuable island resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40528684/ad974e44630513e7b11d9783516ef5604edbb840.png[/img]

[h3]⚓ Call to Arms:[/h3] Will ye join our crew, share in the adventure, and grow with us? Hoist the Jolly Roger and embark on this epic voyage!

notes.title: ☠️ YAARRGH! Journey's End and a New Beginning! 🚀🌌
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TwFZonJhqSw;full][/previewyoutube]

As our prototype era gracefully concludes, a new chapter in our game development journey unfolds! 🎮✨ Join us for a momentous glimpse into the evolution of our project. The end of an era signals the birth of something extraordinary, as we set the stage for the next phase of development. Get ready for a captivating transition as creativity takes the lead. The journey continues, and we invite you to witness the magic! 🌟

This past year, we poured our heart and soul into rebuilding our voxel engine, crafting a masterpiece of speed and aesthetic brilliance. 🌟💻 Witness the transformation; Islands come alive with newfound beauty. What's more, we've tailored our voxel engine to run seamlessly and natively on the Steam Deck, unlocking a whole new realm of possibilities. Now, at the brink of a new era, we're poised to breathe life into our game using this revamped and optimized engine. Join us as we dive into the thrilling phase of creation. The journey has been incredible, and the best is yet to come! 🚀🎮

notes.title: 🌱 Explore a World of Voxel Wonders! 🌍
notes.content:
🔍 Uncover Procedural Beauty: Delve into the heart of our gaming universe, where every corner reveals a new surprise. Our procedural world-building technology ensures that no two landscapes are alike, guaranteeing an endless array of unique environments for you to discover.

⛏️ Craft Your Path: Embrace the spirit of exploration and creativity as you shape the world around you. With intuitive tools and limitless possibilities, you can build, modify, and transform the terrain, creating your own mark on this vibrant voxel canvas.

📽️ Witness the Magic: Curious to see the enchantment for yourself? Watch our latest testing build video on YouTube to catch a glimpse of the wonders that await. 

[previewyoutube=ohLZQU_y9oQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Join us on this epic journey as we continue to shape our gaming universe. ✨
